tools.name: get_current_customer
tools.title: Get current EPLUS customer
tools.description: Return the signed-in customer's own EPLUS profile. Use this to confirm which EPLUS account is connected. Never use a name or customer code supplied in chat as proof of identity.

tools.name: list_my_orders
tools.title: List my orders
tools.description: List the signed-in user's EPLUS shop orders with optional order-number, status and date filters. Returns a small page newest first; ask before loading more. All totals are CAD.

tools.name: list_my_forwardings
tools.title: List my forwarding orders
tools.description: List the signed-in user's forwarding orders with optional request-number, status and date filters. Returns a small page; ask before loading more. All totals are CAD.

tools.name: get_my_order
tools.title: Get my shop order details
tools.description: Get one shop order belonging to the signed-in customer, including items and waybills. All money is returned in CAD. This tool cannot pay.

tools.name: get_my_forwarding
tools.title: Get my forwarding order details
tools.description: Get one forwarding order belonging to the signed-in customer, including items and waybills. All money is returned in CAD. This tool cannot pay.

tools.name: track_waybill
tools.title: Track a waybill
tools.description: Look up a SinoCargo waybill by its waybill number. Access is scoped by RLS to waybills the signed-in user owns.

tools.name: list_forwarding_routes
tools.title: List available forwarding routes
tools.description: List forwarding routes currently available to the signed-in EPLUS customer. Monetary pricing is always CAD. Do not choose a route until destination, cargo type, weight and required dimensions are known; ask when information is missing.

tools.name: quote_forwarding_cad
tools.title: Quote forwarding in CAD
tools.description: Calculate an EPLUS forwarding estimate from the active database pricing rule after route, weight, required dimensions and declared CAD value are known. Never guess missing measurements. Every monetary value is CAD, never CNY/RMB.

tools.name: save_forwarding_draft
tools.title: Save a forwarding draft
tools.description: Create or update the signed-in customer's forwarding draft. This does not create an order. All item values must be CAD; never convert or relabel them as yuan. For fields derived from media or speech, show the structured draft and obtain explicit confirmation before saving; never guess unreadable values.

tools.name: confirm_forwarding_draft
tools.title: Confirm and create forwarding order
tools.description: Create the real forwarding order from the exact saved draft version the customer just reviewed, only after explicit confirmation of the final CAD summary. If the version changed, review again. Never call this tool merely to save or preview a draft.

expected_version.description: Version returned by the immediately preceding get_forwarding_draft review.

confirmation.description: Must be CONFIRM after the customer explicitly approves the final summary.

tools.name: list_my_addresses
tools.title: List my delivery addresses
tools.description: List a small page of the signed-in customer's own saved EPLUS delivery addresses for choosing an address_id. Ask before loading more.

tools.name: get_forwarding_draft
tools.title: Review a forwarding draft
tools.description: Retrieve the signed-in customer's draft. Present every item, route, address, and CAD value before asking for confirmation.

tools.name: cancel_forwarding_draft
tools.title: Cancel a forwarding draft
tools.description: Cancel the signed-in customer's active forwarding draft only after explicit confirmation. This never cancels an already-created order.

tools.name: get_owner_dashboard
tools.title: Get EPLUS owner dashboard
tools.description: Read current EPLUS operational counts using the signed-in owner's permissions. It never changes data.

tools.name: search_customers_owner
tools.title: Search EPLUS customers as owner
tools.description: Search customers using the signed-in owner's permissions. Read-only and limited to 50 results.

tools.name: list_pending_forwardings_owner
tools.title: List pending EPLUS forwardings as owner
tools.description: Read pending or unpaid forwarding orders using the signed-in owner's permissions. Monetary values are CAD.

tools.name: update_forwarding_basic_info_owner
tools.title: Update forwarding basic information as owner
tools.description: Owner-only mapping of the existing EPLUS admin basic-info edit. Review the latest order and obtain explicit confirmation first.

tools.name: get_forwarding_owner
tools.title: Get a forwarding order as owner
tools.description: Read one forwarding order using the signed-in owner's permissions. Use immediately before proposing any write action.

tools.name: get_waybill_admin
tools.title: Get waybill with admin permissions
tools.description: Mapping of the existing EPLUS admin waybill detail view. Uses the signed-in account's normal staff permission.

tools.name: set_waybill_status_manager
tools.title: Set waybill status with manager permissions
tools.description: Mapping of the existing EPLUS setWaybillStatus operation. Requires Owner/Manager permission, a fresh review, explicit confirmation, reason, and audit.

tools.name: list_my_items
tools.title: List my saved items
tools.description: List a small page of the signed-in customer's EPLUS My Items library. Filter by a name, SKU, or HS code when possible; ask before loading more. Values are CAD.

tools.name: save_my_item
tools.title: Add or edit my saved item
tools.description: Add or edit an item in the signed-in customer's existing EPLUS My Items feature. Declared value is always CAD. For fields derived from media or speech, show the structured fields and obtain explicit confirmation first; never guess unreadable or missing values.

tools.name: get_my_wallet
tools.title: Get my wallet and transactions
tools.description: Show the signed-in customer's CAD wallet balance and a small filtered page of completed transactions. Ask before loading more. Read-only and cannot recharge, deduct or refund.

tools.name: list_my_invoices
tools.title: List my invoices
tools.description: List the signed-in customer's invoices with optional invoice-number, status and date filters. Returns a small page; ask before loading more. All money is CAD.

tools.name: delete_my_item
tools.title: Delete one of my saved items
tools.description: Delete one item from the signed-in customer's existing My Items feature after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: get_my_invoice
tools.title: Get my invoice details
tools.description: Get one invoice belonging to the signed-in customer, with customer-facing line amounts converted to CAD.

tools.name: save_my_address
tools.title: Add or edit my delivery address
tools.description: Add or edit a delivery address in the signed-in customer's existing EPLUS address book. For fields derived from media or speech, show the exact address fields and obtain explicit confirmation first; never guess.

tools.name: delete_my_address
tools.title: Delete my delivery address
tools.description: Delete an address belonging to the signed-in customer after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: update_my_profile
tools.title: Update my EPLUS profile
tools.description: Update the signed-in customer's existing EPLUS profile, registered address, language, and invoice contact fields. Login email and account security are not changed.

tools.name: get_my_inventory
tools.title: Get my warehouse inventory
tools.description: Show a small page of the signed-in customer's waybills currently in storage and preview total storage fees in CAD. Ask before loading more. This tool cannot pay fees.

tools.name: list_my_batches
tools.title: List my shipping batches
tools.description: List the signed-in customer's visible EPLUS batches using the same fee-summary logic as the customer website. Amounts are CAD. This tool cannot pay a batch.

tools.name: search_orders_admin
tools.title: Search shop orders with staff permissions
tools.description: Search EPLUS shop orders using the signed-in account's normal staff permission. Read-only; all totals are CAD.

tools.name: get_order_admin
tools.title: Get shop order details with staff permissions
tools.description: Read one EPLUS shop order, customer, items and waybills using the signed-in account's normal staff permission. Read-only; all money is CAD.

tools.name: get_customer_admin
tools.title: Get customer details with staff permissions
tools.description: Read an EPLUS customer's profile, account counts, CAD wallet balance and recent business records using the signed-in account's normal staff permission. This tool cannot pay or deduct funds.

tools.name: search_invoices_admin
tools.title: Search invoices with staff permissions
tools.description: Search EPLUS invoices using the signed-in account's normal staff permission. Read-only; all money is CAD. This tool cannot pay, refund, deduct funds, or change payment status.

tools.name: get_invoice_admin
tools.title: Get invoice details with staff permissions
tools.description: Read one EPLUS invoice, customer and line items using the signed-in account's normal staff permission. Read-only; all money is CAD. This tool cannot pay, refund, deduct funds, or change payment status.

tools.name: search_forwardings_admin
tools.title: Search forwarding orders with staff permissions
tools.description: Search EPLUS forwarding orders across statuses using the signed-in account's normal staff permission. Read-only; all customer-facing money is CAD. When results exceed 5, summarize and ask the user to narrow the search instead of displaying all records.

tools.name: search_waybills_admin
tools.title: Search waybills with staff permissions
tools.description: Search EPLUS waybills by tracking number, customer, shop order or forwarding request using the signed-in account's normal staff permission. Read-only and CAD-only. When results exceed 5, summarize and ask the user to narrow the search.

tools.name: search_batches_admin
tools.title: Search shipping batches with staff permissions
tools.description: Search EPLUS shipping batches using normal staff permissions. Read-only and CAD-only; summarize results over 5 and ask the user to narrow them.

tools.name: get_batch_admin
tools.title: Get shipping batch details with staff permissions
tools.description: Read one EPLUS batch and its waybill summary using normal staff permissions. Read-only, CAD-only, and cannot charge customers or change batch status.

tools.name: search_audit_logs_admin
tools.title: Search admin audit logs
tools.description: Search EPLUS admin audit summaries using the signed-in owner's permission. Read-only. Do not bulk-display logs; summarize results over 5 and ask for a narrower date, operator, entity or action.

tools.name: get_audit_log_admin
tools.title: Get one admin audit log
tools.description: Read one selected EPLUS admin audit record, including before and after snapshots, using owner permissions. Never expose bulk audit details.
